mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with an air quality index of 52. Since it is a new moon tonight, keep an eye out for the International Space Station, which will be visible starting at 9:08 PM. It will rise in the West over Mount Horeb and travel toward the Northeast near the Home Depot, reaching about halfway up the sky.

City Hall has released several important election notices for the upcoming general election in November, and the city continues to provide ongoing engineering service updates through AECOM Inc. for review by the City Council.

There is plenty to do in our community. We have live music happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market and more music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
Regarding the weekly report, on Sunday, August 30, 2026, the Verona Police Department began an investigation that resulted in the arrest of a Madison resident for an incident involving a student.
Today's delicious flavor at Culver's is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open and will remain open until 11:00 PM tonight.
